nodes.label: Checker Pattern PNG (Heroslider Asset)
nodes.description: A very small, mostly dark/near-black image that appears to be a checkerboard or checker pattern tile. The pattern is extremely subtle with very low contrast, likely near-black on black or very dark gray alternating squares. Used as a background texture or overlay asset in the heroslider content block, possibly as a transparency indicator or subtle dark texture for overlay effects on hero slider images.
